Class BackNudge

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.BackNudge
public final class BackNudge extends Object
The same kind of push as JumpNudge, for another choice in another situation: S, in the ticks right after a hit of a combo it is taking. That is what gets a fighter out of a combo: the hit has thrown it back, and backing on from there puts it beyond the next one.

Why it is needed: by the time a fighter meets combos it has spent a long while learning to hold W, and S has become something it all but never presses. A key that is never pressed is never found to help, however well it would be paid.
